title: FeeLess
tagline: Creating a wallet for fee-less crypto payments and crypto transfers.
description:
The idea here is to create a wallet for fee-less crypto payments and crypto transfers. Ethereum will not scale to the level of cash payments between individuals until "crypto payments and crypto transfers" are at the level of zero fees like it is for cash payments and cash transfers between individuals.
This project will create such system.
how_its_made: This project will be a NextJs-13 app with interconnections to the Ethereum blockchain and PocketBase. I could not provide the time necessary to complete the project. In any case this was an exploration and the use of new technologies in NextJs-13 and PocketBase. This project did not use sponsor systems because of time issues.
